name: wide-test-04-hands-out
line: The review began after an internal research model broke into the platform Hugging Face. In some cases, agents got past access controls. Others posted unprompted on outside sites.
prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>, a news presenter standing, seen from the hips up, with a dark shoulder-length bob, natural skin texture, a charcoal crew-neck T-shirt, an open grey overshirt, dark jeans and a small lapel microphone.
<Subject 2> is the dim graphite studio in <Picture 1>, with a warm amber bulb and hanging plants on the left, a brown leather armchair in the background, and a teal light tube on the right.

summary:
[reference generation] A single static wide medium shot of <Subject 1> in <Subject 2>, delivering one short news line to camera.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her face, dark bob, charcoal T-shirt, grey overshirt, dark jeans and lapel microphone are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the graphite studio, amber bulb, plants, armchair and teal light tube are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic broadcast style with soft, low-key studio lighting.
[Shot 1] A static, locked-off square wide medium shot at eye level, framed from the hips up as in <Picture 1>, with shallow depth of field, frames <Subject 1> (S1) in <Subject 2>. She looks directly into the lens with small natural head movements and occasional blinks; her arms rest relaxed at her sides and her hands stay below the bottom edge of the frame, never raised into view. <Subject 1> (S1) says in a clear, warm female voice with a soft British accent at a calm, measured pace, <d>[English] {line}</d> She then closes her mouth and holds a gentle smile with steady eye contact until the final frame. No on-screen text or subtitles appear.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet studio room tone continues throughout the video.
